All **22 private patches** apply to their pinned source. All six vLLM patches pass lint and format checks.

Do you want a new GPU limit for this five-hour audit? I will continue with CPU and source checks if you do not reply. The previous GPU allowance is closed.
- No paid GPU jobs
- Allow 10 total GPU minutes
- Allow 20 total GPU minutes

The five-hour audit finished at **11:04 IST**. It used **15.37 of 20 GPU minutes**. All audit resources are stopped.

- **Best new speed draft:** combine block-table gathering and slot mapping. The H100 prototype used **27–34% less GPU component time**, saving about **2 µs per call**. Production GPU, UVA, padding and model checks remain open.
- **Strongest correctness fix:** MLA cache restoration. The native model check confirmed that the fix updates the real cache storage.
- **Next for human review:** MLA, PCP counting, compact warmup and DeepGEMM metadata. Each retains its stated test limits.
- **Held or rejected:** MoE and the FP8 guard have mixed results. Split-table mapping made the complete caller **82–89% slower**, so it is rejected.
- **Next heavy-path lead:** one FP8 fallback repeats full-weight conversion. An existing CUTLASS route could avoid it. Source checks pass, but numerical, model and speed checks remain open.

The alternatives review found useful designs in other engines. It did not establish a faster engine at a matched measurement boundary.

**No large whole-engine speedup is proved.** All drafts remain local. No PR was published.
